reponse: To turn on the new dashboards locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` while the API is running [2][3]. The old build-time environment variable `FEATURE_FLAGS` in `.env.local` is now ignored because flags are served from the API [2][3]. After running the command, hard-reload the page and verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3].
